goal: Accessibility and text audit, touching only what a mouse-and-keyboard player would: every screen and panel; cut-off, overlapping, unclear or misspelled text; contrast; anything only explained on hover.

findings.title: Settlement world label renders huge, clipped off-screen and buried under HUD near your own settlement
findings.detail: After founding and while standing in/near the settlement, the floating label 'Camp of Oldtown / 0 here, 1/8 residents' is drawn at enormous size, cut off by the top edge and overlapped by the status bar, chronicle panel, error banners and toasts. The key info about your own settlement can't be read. Expected a size-clamped label, or one placed clear of the HUD.
findings.repro: pt start --seed 109; Start, Begin; gather 50 wood; N; walk until F succeeds (~(-13,277)); pt shot

findings.title: Chronicle HUD lines truncated with '...' and no way to read them on hover, incl. your own nation's name
findings.detail: HUD chronicle lines end mid-word: 'You raised a banner and named your people Ol...', 'declared the nation of Farmland, tho...', 'have become rivals ov...'. Hovering gives no tooltip. The announcement of the player's own nation cuts off its name. The full text is only in the Y window. Also, the player is never asked to name the nation; it is auto-named.
findings.repro: Start a world; press N; pt move 500 84; pt shot

findings.title: No tooltips anywhere: HUD, Config, Nations/Laws actions and disabled buttons are unexplained
findings.detail: Hovering Config options (Chunk Size, Location Scale, Lag Prevention, Respawn Pawns), the HUD 'Village: 0/4' and Era box, Nations actions (Tribute/Ally/War/Denounce) and greyed buttons (Build Stall, Build Farm, Enter Settlement) shows no tooltip. Laws only describe the currently selected option, so a player can't see what Low/High tax, Conscription On or Borders Open do before committing a 30 s change. 'Tribute 25 coins for +10' and 'Defence 1' don't say what the number measures.
findings.repro: Main menu > Config, hover each label; in world press O, hover Denounce; click Laws, hover Low

findings.title: Era panel numbers contradict the HUD (Village 0/4 vs 0/1; day 1/2 vs Day 1/3)
findings.detail: The collapsed era line reads 'Village: 0/4' but the expanded checklist reads 'Village 0/1'. The checklist's 'Day 1/3' disagrees with the Season panel's 'Spring - day 1/2, year 1'. 'day 1/2' also reads like a fraction.
findings.repro: Start a world; click the Era box at (110,58)

findings.title: Low contrast: title/menus white on light blue (2.5:1), Era header 1.9:1, objective bar text on yellow 1.9:1
findings.detail: Measured: white on the #73A6E6 title, menu, config, load and new-world background is about 2.5:1, and the menu buttons are barely distinguishable from the background. The Era header (#8CD9FF on #4296FA) is about 1.9:1. The white 'Wood 50/50' on the filled yellow objective bar (#E6B300) is about 1.9:1, so it is least legible exactly when the goal is complete. All are below the WCAG 4.5:1 guideline.
findings.repro: pt start; pt shot (title); main menu; in world collect 50 wood

findings.title: Translucent HUD makes enabled vs disabled buttons indistinguishable depending on the scene
findings.detail: In first-person view inside a settlement, the greyed Build Stall/House/Farm look like the enabled Exit Settlement and Withdraw Funds. In bright highlands, Gift/Invite buttons wash out to near-white. 'Send Caravan (Town era)', 'Sell Resources' and 'Purchase Food' are drawn enabled but only produce a red error (no Storehouse / no stalls).
findings.repro: Enter settlement (E), press V; click Sell Resources

findings.title: 'Open ground lies about N to the north' with no compass on the HUD
findings.detail: The too-close settlement error gives a compass direction, but nothing on screen shows which way north is. It took several tries to find the spot.

findings.title: HUD covers over half the 960x540 screen; Inventory Info panel jumps to mid-screen
findings.detail: Era checklist, objective, inventory, 5-line chronicle, season, player info and 2-4 rows of action buttons leave little of the world visible. When the era panel grows, Inventory Info moves from the left column into the middle of the view. No way was found to collapse panels.

findings.title: Gather feedback inconsistent: status says 3 apples, float says +2, saplings omitted
findings.detail: First chop: status 'Gathered 5 wood and 3 apples from tree.', floating '+2 apples', inventory 2. Energy rose 83->96, so one apple was eaten without any message. The status line leaves out the +2 saplings. The floating +N text is pale on bright foliage and is often hidden under the 'Objective complete!' toast.
findings.repro: Start; pt walkto tree; pt key e

findings.title: Inside-settlement layout glitch: objective text overprints a hidden button for a frame
findings.detail: On entering the settlement, the Objective 6 panel overflowed onto a half-hidden 'Send Caravan (Town era)' button and both texts overlapped. The layout fixed itself a few frames later, but at about 2 fps this is visible for a while.
findings.repro: Walk to own settlement, press E, pt shot immediately

findings.title: Chronicle window: translucent, cryptic '3 entries. Listing 2.', overlapping filters
findings.detail: Panels behind the Y window bleed through its lower half. The header '3 entries. Listing 2.' doesn't say why one entry is hidden. There are three overlapping filters (Your news/All nations, 'Only my nation', Y cycles views), and the entry order is the reverse of the HUD.

findings.title: Jargon: 'Export replay (USD)', 'Rival', 'Chunk Size'; volume label says sound only in browser
findings.detail: 'USD' reads as US dollars. 'border quarrels stop at Rival' never defines Rival. The Config volume label reads '(sound plays in the browser version)' but desktop still shows Volume/Mute.

findings.title: Inventory/pause/nations overlays have no backing panel; player capsule draws over text
findings.detail: The I, Esc and O screens draw text straight onto the dimmed 3D world. The player capsule sits on 'Apples/Saplings' in Inventory, on 'World seed 109' in Pause and between the Nations buttons. A tip number was also skipped (Tip 1 then Tip 3 of 5).

findings.title: Controls help page 3 lists debug cheats (F2-F6) to all players
findings.detail: A third of the Controls screen documents spawn-coins/wood/pawns cheats. Otherwise the Controls screen is the most legible screen in the game.

verdict: The text is mostly well written and the error messages are helpful: too-close distances, 'Click again to confirm' on war, and a 'Sure?' prompt on delete. Legibility is the problem. Low-contrast light-blue menus, translucent panels whose contrast depends on the scene, truncated chronicle lines, and a giant clipped settlement label all get in the way. The game has no tooltips at all, so every number (Village 0/4, +10, Defence 1) and every greyed button is left for the player to guess.
